artifact.testable_hypothesis: Under fixed cell chemistry and cycling protocol, additive concentration changes retention and impedance, with SEI composition as a candidate mediator rather than a proven mechanism.

variable_table.name: capacity retention

variable_table.success_threshold: pre-register minimum improvement over no-additive control

variable_table.name: interfacial resistance

baseline_fairness_criteria: only additive concentration changes between baseline and treatment
matched sample preparation and measurement order
ablation_or_comparison_matrix: 0 additive vs low additive vs high additive
retention/EIS only vs retention/EIS plus SEI characterization
replicate batch A vs replicate batch B if resources allow
analysis_plan: lock primary metric and cycle count before running
separate outcome effect from mediator interpretation
report uncertainty and failed quality checks
treat SEI composition as explanatory only after matched-condition evidence
success_failure_thresholds: primary success requires retention improvement and no worse safety/stability flag
mechanism claim requires matched SEI evidence plus outcome link
